query:
WITH removed AS (
            DELETE FROM media_files
            WHERE source_id = $2
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT FROM UNNEST($3::text[]) AS listed (path)
                    WHERE listed.path = media_files.path
                )
            RETURNING 1
        )
        UPDATE media_imports
        SET file_count = $4, removed_file_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM removed)
        WHERE id = $1
